measured_by: issue #1238 lane (governance-isolation), measured finding from scripts/check-isolation-landed.sh on a pristine detached worktree at origin/master
note: Recorded legacy for the ticket-trailer rule over LANDED history (issue #287). Every commit here landed AFTER the shared predicate's enforcement boundary and still does not carry the ticket reference in a trailing trailer block, as measured -- not assumed -- by `scripts/check-pr-contract.sh --landed`. They are RECORDED, not accepted: `governance/isolation/cli.py enforce` reports them on every run. An entry is ADDED only by an explicit, reviewed commit to this file -- never automatically, and never to silence a run. That review IS the control, and it is the only admissible terminal state for post-boundary residue: the commit is already squash-merged onto a protected branch, so its message cannot be corrected (history is never rewritten, GR hard floor), and the gate that caught it has no other way to close. A NEW violation therefore still reds the gate FIRST; recording it is the follow-up decision, not the fix (#836). Nothing is ever dropped from this list silently: an entry whose commit now complies (`quarantine-entry-stale`) or is outside the assessed range (`quarantine-entry-not-assessed`) fails the check, and a missing or malformed baseline fails rather than skipping. The list SHRANK by issue #835 (2026-09-15): the predicate's trailer line now includes GitHub's own bare auto-close keyword (`Closes #<n>`), which is the paragraph the landing path composes (`gh pr merge --squash` over a body ending in a bare `Closes #<n>`), so the 8 entries whose trailing paragraph had that shape now COMPLY -- each re-checked, the shared predicate reporting rc 0 for it -- and were removed. 14 entries became 6. The 6 that remain are the shapes the rule still refuses by design: the reference separated from the trailing block by prose (`commit-ref-outside-the-trailer-block`), or no reference at all (`commit-missing-ticket-trailer`). The list GREW by one entry by issue #1154 (2026-09-17): `origin/master`'s own tip `2fa292c` (the squash-merge of #1150) carried no trailing trailer and was not recorded, so `scripts/check-isolation-landed.sh` refused a pristine `origin/master` (rc=1) and blocked every open PR's `make verify`. The composition surfaces were intact -- the PR template ends in the trailer and the landing driver composes one -- and the queue's pre-merge guard refuses this very PR when run directly (`bash scripts/check-squash-message.sh --pr 1150` -> rc=1 `commit-missing-ticket-trailer`); #1150 was instead merged DIRECTLY by the owner (kushin77, 2026-09-17T16:05:52Z), bypassing `scripts/pr-queue.sh` and its guard. The gap is therefore ENFORCEMENT on the non-queue merge path (findings filed to #1145), not composition; recording this residue is the review-gated terminal state the doctrine requires, and it does not prevent the next direct merge. It recurred within three minutes of #1169 (the #1154 fix) landing: #1171 (`0aa836c`, merged directly by the owner 2026-09-17T17:38:25Z, its own body declaring `check-isolation-landed` a pre-existing failure) redded master before the fix could be observed green -- recorded by issue #1172, and the measured proof that recording residue is not prevention. It recurred AGAIN, faster, by issue #1186 (2026-09-17T20:46Z): FOUR unrecorded post-boundary commits were measured reachable in pristine origin/master -- 04ad55a8d4ec (squash of #1191), e4f1c135409f (#1188), ea391d9a863b (#1185) and 04e9c1af08ff (#1177). Each is a squash-merge whose message carries no `Refs`/`Closes` anywhere and whose LAST paragraph is only `Co-authored-by` (measured per commit with git show -s --format=%B; none is in this list before this entry). Three of the four landed 19:10Z / 19:40Z / 20:31Z -- AFTER the first was measured -- so the residue GREW from one commit to four while the recording lane for the first was still open: the same class, now compounding. All four are recorded here by an explicit reviewed commit (issue #1186), each re-measured, not assumed. The enforcement gap remains on the non-queue/direct-merge path and is tracked by issue #1145, not fixed here. A FIFTH offender landed while this very entry was under review: `fc4bd93` (squash-merge of #1196, `fix(cloudbuild): use sh not bash in apply.yaml's terraform steps`), measured the same way (no `Refs`/`Closes`; last paragraph only `Co-authored-by`), so the set recorded by issue #1186 is FIVE -- the counts grew from two to five across the life of one lane. It recurred YET AGAIN by issue #1214 (2026-09-17T22:54Z): `75e10e30d52f` (squash-merge of #1213, `fix(terraform): valid cross-variable validation for web-surface edge cutover`) landed on `origin/master`'s own tip with no `Refs`/`Closes` anywhere and a last paragraph of only `Co-authored-by` -- the sixth recurrence of this class in one day. Recorded here by an explicit reviewed commit (issue #1214), re-measured, not assumed. The enforcement gap remains #1145; this baseline only unblocks, it does not prevent the next one. It recurred AGAIN, immediately, by issue #1224 (2026-09-17T23:22Z): `2964d65` -- #1221's OWN merge commit, whose entire purpose was recording the #1214 finding -- put `Closes #1214` under a `## Closes` heading at the TOP of the body instead of the trailing block, and `b0adff3` (#1223) landed alongside it with no reference at all. Seventh and eighth recurrence of the class in one day; the remedy retired itself (a squash commit cannot record its own SHA before it exists, #836). Both recorded here by an explicit reviewed commit (issue #1224), re-measured. #1145 remains the only durable fix. The list GREW AGAIN by issue #1228 (2026-09-17T23:3xZ): `b81f18ad3889` is the squash-merge of #1225, the SECOND consecutive unblock lane to land the very defect it was recording -- its final paragraph is a bare `Closes #<n>` with zero `Refs` lines. Measured: #1221 (2964d65, merged 22:57:41Z) trailer-less, then #1225 (b81f18a, merged 23:19:54Z) trailer-less, in 22 minutes, from two different lanes -- and a third lane's identical PR had to be closed twice as superseded. Three independent measurements of the same recurrence and three identical remedies is the strongest possible statement that recording residue is not a control: the rate must be cut at the producer, which is issue #1145's other half (the guarded merge entrypoint the agent instruction now names).
